name: BARTEC ET60/65EX2 Windows
summary: The BARTEC ET60/65EX2 Windows is the hazardous-area version of a BARTEC rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Professional.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2026-07-21), checked 2026-10-26. ATEX EPS 26 ATEX 1 034 X confirmed by BARTEC EU DoC B1-T2E0-7C0003 (ET60EX2 Windows, 2026-08-11; Bureau Veritas CPS Germany, NB 2004; Category 3, internal production control).

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery pack changed or charged only outside hazardous areas; only battery pack type B7-T2Z0-0002 shall be used; connection or disconnection of external ports, opening the enclosure or replacing the battery live only if the atmosphere is shown to be absent; protect from high-energy impacts and high electrostatic charge; follow the manufacturer's safety instructions.
safety.peripherals: Ports (USB-A, Thunderbolt/USB-C, dock, keyboard connector) only if the atmosphere is shown to be absent; the supplied screws locking the I/O ports and the battery must be tightened when used in hazardous areas; charging accessories are required but not included.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in IECEx EPS 26.0013X as 'accessories for use in hazardous areas': battery B7-T2Z0-0002 (7.6 V / 4460 mAh), kickstand with hand strap B7-T2Z0-0003, hand strap B7-T2Z0-0004, shoulder strap B7-T2Z0-0006, stylus holder B7-T2Z0-0009, screen protector B7-T2Z0-0011, leather holster B7-T2Z0-0012, 4-point belt B7-T2Z0-0013, integrated stylus B7-T2Z0-0014, stylus 17-S1Z0-0008. Battery changing and charging only outside hazardous areas.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 11 Professional (64-bit); feature version not stated
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.display: 10.1-inch Optically bonded capacitive multi-touch, Corning Gorilla Glass, contrast 1000:1
specs.outdoor: 1000-nit display, 'easy to see' in bright sunlight (maker)
specs.frontCamera: 5 MP RGB with mechanical privacy shade
specs.ports: 1 x USB 3.1 Type A; 2 x Thunderbolt 4/USB4 Type C; docking connector; keyboard connector; 1 x USB 2.0 (rear); optional SE55 scan engine
specs.network: ET60 Wi-Fi 7; ET65 adds 5G NR / LTE
specs.nfc: Yes (ISO 14443 A/B, MIFARE, FeliCa, ISO 15693, NFC Forum 1-4)
specs.gnss: ET65: GPS, GLONASS, BDS, Galileo, QZSS
specs.keys: Power, scan, up/down (programmable), three programmable keys
specs.touch: Bare finger, heavy-gloved finger or active/passive stylus (maker); use in heavy rain claimed
specs.ruggedness: 1.5 m to concrete exceeds MIL-STD-810H; 1.8 m to plywood

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Via app (three programmable keys, no dedicated SOS key)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (optional SE55 1D/2D Advanced Range scan engine; changes the Ex marking to 'op is')

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (rear and front cameras, privacy shade; third-party app)

variants.name: Marking versions
variants.description: The certification covers more than one version: ATEX with scan engine: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc; without: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc | IECEx the same without 'II 3G' | ATEX with scan engine: II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64; without: II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64 | IECEx the same without 'II 3D'

unconfirmed.specs.wifi: From a single or secondary source; the maker doesn't state it for this model.
unconfirmed.removable: Not stated by the maker for this exact model.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
